name: Centro (Plaza Borda and Santa Prisca)
tagline: Historic heart beneath the pink church
description: The postcard core of Taxco, wrapped around Plaza Borda and the baroque Santa Prisca church. Cobbled lanes, silver shops, cafes and terrace restaurants cluster here, buzzing by day and softly lit by night, always framed by whitewashed hillside houses.
bestFor: Nomads wanting cafe wifi, walkable amenities and daily immersion in Taxco's iconic centre
pros: Walkable to everything and cafe wifi
Lively plaza with dining and silver markets
cons: Steep, busy and can be noisy

name: Upper Barrios (near Ojeda)
tagline: Quiet residential streets high above town
description: The upper neighbourhoods climbing toward Ojeda offer a more local, residential feel away from the tourist bustle. Steeper still than the centre, these barrios reward the effort with sweeping rooftop views, cheaper rentals and everyday Taxco life among long-standing families.
bestFor: Budget-minded, Spanish-speaking nomads happy with steep walks and authentic neighbourhood life

name: Los Arcos (entrance area)
tagline: Gateway district by the town arches
description: Around Los Arcos, near the main entrance to Taxco, the town meets its approach roads. Slightly flatter and more accessible, this area suits arrivals and those needing easier bus and taxi links, while staying within reach of the historic centre uphill.
bestFor: Nomads valuing transport links and gentler terrain over central plaza atmosphere
pros: Easier access to buses and taxis
cons: Less charm than the historic centre
A walk or ride uphill to the plaza

name: Monte Taxco (toward the Teleferico)
tagline: Hilltop resort area with cable car
description: High above town toward the Teleferico cable car, the Monte Taxco area offers the best panoramas, resort-style lodging and a peaceful, elevated retreat. It is removed from the centre's bustle, favouring calm, views and space over walkable street life below.
bestFor: Nomads seeking quiet, sweeping views and resort comfort over central walkability
pros: Cable car and resort amenities nearby
